results.snippet: # A.M. Kitco Metals Roundup: Gold Higher on Safe-Haven Investment Demand, Bargain Hunting. **(Kitco News) -** Comex gold futures prices are trading higher to start the new trading week. Some safe-haven demand, bargain hunting and short covering are featured Monday morning. February gold last traded up $8.40 an ounce at $1,713.80. The China news is also a bullish underlying factor for the raw commodity markets, including the precious metals, to start the new trading week. While the market place presently perceives odds are higher than not that there will be a last-minute agreement among U.S. lawmakers to avoid the fiscal cliff, the overall situation continues to be a bearish drag on many markets, including the raw commodities and stock markets.
